extractionMethod.description: Located the unique anchor string JSON.parse('{"parserVersion" inside the bundle, character-scanned forward from the opening quote to find the matching unescaped closing quote (honoring backslash escaping), decoded the resulting JS string-literal token via new Function('return '+literal)(), then JSON.parse()d the decoded string.

notes: This file (provenance.json) intentionally contains no wall-clock timestamp fields describing "when extracted", to keep pipeline output byte-for-byte deterministic across reruns against the same bundle. See extraction-report.md for a human-readable summary with a generation date.
